notes.defenseFactor: PvE damage reduction is 10% of (Defense - Penetration), flat per hit. gameplay.tips damage formula guide (KR-derived).
notes.critPerPoint: Crit chance rises 0.1% per Critical Hit point above the target's Critical Hit Resist, capped at 80% (800 points over resist). aion2.akunito.com stats page.
notes.critCap: 80% cap. aion2.akunito.com; a 50% cap is a rumour.
notes.critDamageBase: Crits deal 1.5x before Critical Damage Boost; Critical Damage Boost is additive to that base.
notes.multiHitExtraHits: Multi-hit adds 1-4 extra hits (uniform average 2.5). Placement in the formula is unconfirmed; treated as an expected-value multiplier.
notes.multiHitHitFraction: Each extra multi-hit hit deals about 5% of the hit (gameplay.tips; akunito says 10-15%). Calibrate against DPS-meter logs.
notes.powerShardMultiplier: A regular Power Shard multiplies weapon attack by about 4.65% (gameplay.tips).
